name: Railcraft Steel Tank 5x5
notes: Railcraft steel tank, 5x5 footprint (Railcraft 9.17.31, the version in GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3). Hollow cube of walls; gauges and valves are optional and may replace any wall that is not on the edge (not modelled here, so all cells are walls). Height 4 to 8 blocks. Must be at least one block from another tank (minGap 1). Not tiered. The default Railcraft config allows only 3x3 tanks; the larger sizes need the maxsize setting raised.
